notes.title: i fixed it guys
notes.content:
hey y'all, i finally decided to update my old game. this means

- ui is no longer broken (sorry for not fixing that for a year lol)

- i've made some subtle changes to clear up story related confusion for future game theorists

- i tweaked a couple materials in level 11 that looked weird

- if you care to datamine, i left a demo in the files for an indoor level generation system (it was going to be used for a backrooms project that I scrapped)
